description: This file contains utility functions for handling theme configurations in a UI project, including serialization, deserialization, normalization, and extraction of system colors, specifically tailored for integration with Ant Design themes.

methods.name: isSerializableConfig
methods.description: Checks if a theme config is serializable by detecting string-based algorithm

methods.name: deserializeThemeConfig
methods.description: Converts a serializable theme config to an Ant Design ThemeConfig

methods.name: serializeThemeConfig
methods.description: Converts an Ant Design ThemeConfig to a serializable format

methods.name: normalizeThemeConfig
methods.description: Normalizes any theme config to a standard AntdThemeConfig, automatically detecting and converting serializable configs

methods.name: getAntdConfig
methods.description: Creates default Ant Design configuration from tokens and dark mode preference

methods.name: getSystemColors
methods.description: Extracts system colors from Ant Design tokens
